content.text: Bartholin glands (aka greater vestibular glands) are located in the vulva
Blockage of the Bartholin ducts is a common etiology of a vulvar mass
•larger cysts can cause discomfort, typically during sexual intercourse, sitting, or ambulating
Clinical dx based on physical exam
I&D regardless if cyst or abscess

Lichen sclerosis is a benign, chronic, progressive dermatologic condition characterized by marked inflammation, epithelial thinning, & distinctive dermal changes accompanied by symptoms of pruritis & pain
Pruritis & soreness or irritation are MC sxs
•vulvar pruritis – so intense, may interfere w/ sleep
white, atrophic papules that may coalesce into plaques
Skin thickening in pts w/ vulvar dermatitis secondary to repetitive rubbing & scratching (“itch-scratch cycle”)
thickening of vulvar skin & accentuation of normal skin markings
•labial skin folds are greatly exaggerated, often edematous, and pubic hair can be broken or sparse
If no improvement after 3mo → vulvar bx
Characterized by erosive, papular, or hypertrophic lesions on the vulva w/ or w/o vaginal involvement
Vulvar pain, burning, pruritis, soreness, dyspareunia
Persistent vulvar pain for at least 3mo that has no identifiable cause
Also have pain w/ tampon insertion, tight clothing, prolonged sitting, etc.
, antidepressants, anticonvulsants, steroid injections, topical creams
